claim_details: Customer filed for basement flooding caused by a burst pipe. Policy explicitly excludes 'standing water from ground saturation'.
denial_reason: The damage was caused by ground saturation (seepage), not sudden pipe burst.
policy_text: We do not cover loss caused by water below the surface of the ground, including water which exerts pressure on or flows, seeps or leaks through a building, sidewalk, driveway, foundation, swimming pool or other structure.

claim_details: Customer claimed roof damage after a storm. Inspector found the shingles were 25 years old and deteriorated naturally, not from wind.
denial_reason: Damage is due to age/wear and tear, not a specific storm event.
policy_text: We do not insure for loss caused by: Wear and tear, marring, deterioration, hidden or latent defect or any quality in property that causes it to damage or destroy itself.

claim_details: Customer installed a turbocharger on their sedan which caused engine failure. The policy covers stock parts only.
denial_reason: Unapproved aftermarket modification caused the failure.
policy_text: Coverage is excluded for any vehicle that has been modified, customized, or altered in any way that increases performance beyond manufacturer specifications.

claim_details: Accident occurred while delivering pizzas. Personal auto policy excludes commercial use.
denial_reason: Vehicle was being used for commercial delivery at time of accident.
policy_text: We do not provide Liability Coverage for any 'insured' for that 'insured's' liability arising out of the ownership or operation of a vehicle while it is being used as a public or livery conveyance.

claim_details: Customer left keys in ignition with doors unlocked at a gas station. Car was stolen.
policy_text: We will not pay for loss or damage resulting from theft if the keys or keyless entry device were left in or on the covered vehicle while unattended.
